stem.en: A soap bubble shows shifting swirls of colour rather than one uniform colour, and has no pigment in it at all. What produces the colour?
stem.et: Seebimull näitab muutuvaid värvivõnkeid, mitte üht ühtlast värvi, ja sellel ei ole üldse pigmenti sees. Mis tekitab värvi?

label.en: Interference between light reflecting off the film's two surfaces, whose path difference depends on the local film thickness
label.et: Interferents kile kahelt pinnalt peegelduva valguse vahel, mille teepikkuste erinevus sõltub kohalikust kile paksusest

label.en: Pigment molecules dissolved in the soap solution
The bubble's spherical shape alone, independent of its thickness
label.et: Ainuüksi mulli kerakujuline vorm, sõltumata selle paksusest

label.en: Refraction of light as it exits the bubble into air
